name: 75454 · Melissa, TX
findings: ZIP 75454 (Melissa) has 23 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (56% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75454 (Melissa) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
